dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings with high-contrast, jagged perimeter transitions from dark exterior fur to lighter interior centers, most prominent along the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity white pixel clusters, with the highest concentration observed on the anterior dorsal region near the neck and head.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral annuli form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship. A cluster of high-intensity blobs near the anterior region forms a dense, irregular polygon.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, high-contrast red circular lesion with visible internal tissue texture located on the dorsal ridge approximately one-third of the body length from the head.
